newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Luka surges ahead of ex-div.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Luka surges ahead of ex-div.

text.p: Slovenian port operator Luka Koper surged 3.98 percent on the Ljubljana bourse on Monday ahead of the share going ex-dividend on Wednesday.

"Luka will go ex-dividend on Wednesday, therefore the current price is expected to be stable or rise slightly further today and tomorrow, while on Wednesday the share is likely to fall by about 100 tolars which is the value of the dividend," one trader said.
By 0945 GMT, Luka was up 68 tolars at 1,775 on volume of 1,029 shares. Traders said the share was unlikely to rise beyond 1,780 tolars in what they said was a generally depressed market.
